faq_heading: 2 bedroom townhomes in Surrey: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a 2 bedroom townhome cost in Surrey?
faq.a: Of the 2 bedroom townhomes in Surrey, 159 sold over the past year at a median of $620,000, with the middle half between $525,000 and $662,000.

faq.q: How long does a 2 bedroom townhome take to sell in Surrey?
faq.a: The median was 39 days, and homes sold for 97.0% of the list price at a median.

faq.q: Which Surrey neighbourhood has the most 2 bedroom townhomes sales?
faq.a: Guildford, with 40 of the 159 sales at a median of $511,500.

faq.q: Which buildings in Surrey have 2 bedroom townhomes for sale most often?
faq.a: By sales over the past year: Chelsea Gardens (10 sales, median $681,950); Lincoln's Gate (7 sales, median $467,900); Holly Park Lane (5 sales, median $442,500); Wyndham Estates (4 sales).

faq.q: What is the strata fee on a 2 bedroom townhome in Surrey?
faq.a: The median strata fee on the 2 bedroom townhomes that sold in Surrey was $373 a month. Fees vary by building, so check the building's own figure.

blocks.text: How 2 bedroom townhomes in Surrey compare
A 2 bedroom townhome in Surrey sold for $170,000 less at the median than a 3 bedroom or larger one ($620,000 against $790,000, 546 sales). The strata fee was $373 a month against $378.
Of the 6 cities with 2 bedroom townhome pages, Surrey has the 4th highest median price. Chilliwack is lowest at $388,750 and South Surrey highest at $780,000.
